headerDisplay: Controls Raspberry Pi, Pico W and ESP32 GPIO from HomeKit over the [ctrlPi](https://ctrlpi.com) REST API. Agent discovery is fully automatic over the LAN. Just list the devices attached to them.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name will appear in the Home App.

agent.title: Hosting agent
agent.description: Name of the agent this device is wired to.

accessory.title: Accessory type
accessory.validationMessage: Please select a real accessory type (do not select category headers).

gpio.title: GPIO
gpio.description: Required. BCM pin on a Pi, GP pin on a Pico, GPIO number on an ESP32.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; const acc = d.accessory; return acc !== 'irrigation' && acc !== 'temperature' && acc !== 'humidity' && acc !== 'lux';

gpio.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

reversed.title: Reversed
reversed.description: Active-low wiring, as most relay boards use. Defaults to false.

pullup.title: Pull resistor

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return ['button','indicator','contact','motion','occupancy','smoke','monoxide','dioxide','leak','lock','garagedoor','valve','shades'].includes(d.accessory) || (d.accessory === 'outlet' && d.inUseGpio !== undefined && d.inUseGpio !== '');

pullup.description: Agent-side pull resistor. Defaults to up if omitted. For combined devices, sets the pull resistor for all its sensors.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Drive the pin, then let the agent revert it. Defaults to false. For shades, enable only for controllers where a second pulse on the same input stops movement.

duration.title: Pulse duration (seconds)
duration.description: Pulse length in seconds. Defaults to 2 seconds for outputs, garage doors, and shades; 3 for locks; 23 for latching valves.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; if (d.accessory === 'irrigation') return false; if (d.accessory === 'valve' && d.valveType !== 2) return false; return ['garagedoor', 'valve', 'lock'].includes(d.accessory) || d.pulse;

duration.validationMessage: Enter seconds from 0.001 to 2147478; decimals are allowed.

tooLong.title: Warn if on for (minutes)
tooLong.description: Log a warning when an output is left on this long. 0 disables.

closeSensor.title: Closed sensor GPIO

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

closeSensor.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

openSensor.title: Open sensor GPIO

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

openSensor.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

timeToOpen.title: Time to open (seconds)

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

timeToOpen.validationMessage: Enter seconds from 0.001 to 2147478; decimals are allowed.
timeToOpen.description: Travel time in seconds. Defaults to 18 seconds if omitted.

timeToClose.title: Time to close (seconds)

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return d.accessory === 'garagedoor' || d.accessory === 'shades';

timeToClose.validationMessage: Enter seconds from 0.001 to 2147478; decimals are allowed.
timeToClose.description: Travel time in seconds. Defaults to 18 seconds if omitted.

valveType.title: Wiring
valveType.description: Wiring mode. Defaults to normally closed, single control.

displayType.title: Shown as
displayType.description: HomeKit valve display. Defaults to generic valve.

closeGpio.title: Close relay GPIO
closeGpio.description: Required, except for pulse shades. The second relay (latching valve, motorized lock, shades).

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return (d.accessory === 'valve' && d.valveType === 2) || (d.accessory === 'lock' && d.lockType === 2) || (d.accessory === 'shades' && d.pulse !== true);

closeGpio.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

valveDuration.title: Run for (minutes)
valveDuration.description: Automatic shutoff time in minutes. Defaults to 20 minutes; 0 disables.

inUseGpio.title: In-Use Sensor GPIO
inUseGpio.description: Input confirming the valve or outlet really is on.
inUseGpio.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

script.title: Sensor script
script.description: Required for this device type. Script the agent runs for this reading: a bare filename in its scripts/ folder, plus letters/digits-only arguments. The plugin configures the sensor from this, so nothing needs setting up on the agent first. The sensor is named after this device.

field.title: Field
field.description: Only if the script returns several fields: which one to read. Leave empty when it returns a single value.

interval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
interval.description: How often the agent runs the script, in seconds. Defaults to 900 seconds (15 minutes). 0 reads once at start only.

doorSensor.title: Door Sensor GPIO
doorSensor.description: Prevents locking if the door is physically open.
doorSensor.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

lockedSensor.title: Locked Sensor GPIO
lockedSensor.description: Hardware feedback confirming the deadbolt is actually thrown.
lockedSensor.validationMessage: Enter a nonnegative whole GPIO number, or leave an optional pin blank.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; return (d.accessory === 'valve' && d.valveType === 2) || (d.accessory === 'lock' && d.lockType === 2) || (d.accessory === 'shades' && d.pulse !== true);

name.title: Zone Name
name.description: Optional. A zone without a name is called GPIO followed by its pin. Leave the whole row empty to skip it.

gpio.title: Zone GPIO
gpio.description: Required for every zone you use.

duration.title: Default duration (minutes)
duration.description: Overrides default run time for this specific zone in minutes. Defaults to 20 minutes.

rescan.title: Rescan Interval
rescan.description: Background agent discovery rescan interval in minutes. Default 60. Set to 0 to disable.

agents.title: Agent Filter
agents.description: Optional whitelist or blacklist to restrict which shared agents this bridge can drive.

list.title: Agents list
list.description: Comma-separated list of agents, e.g. agent1, agent2

sharedConfigPath.title: Shared Config Path
sharedConfigPath.description: Path to the shared agents-config.json to read agents from (read-only). Changes are saved to ctrlpi-agents-config.json in the Homebridge storage folder.

condition.functionBody: const d = (model.devices && model.devices[arrayIndices[0]]) || {}; const acc = d.accessory; return ['button','indicator','contact','motion','occupancy','smoke','monoxide','dioxide','leak','outlet','valve','lock','garagedoor','shades'].includes(acc);
